steps.en: Install the signed build for your OS
steps.zh: 装上对应系统的签名安装包

steps.en: Open the SVG, PDF or .ai file you were sent
steps.zh: 打开别人发来的 SVG、PDF 或 .ai 文件

steps.en: Imports it as editable layers and paths, listing what did not come in
steps.zh: 导入成可编辑的图层和路径，并列出没进来的部分

steps.en: Edit with the Pen, Pathfinder and Appearance panels you know
steps.zh: 用熟悉的钢笔、路径查找器和外观面板编辑

steps.en: Runs each edit as an undoable command and renders off the UI thread
steps.zh: 每次编辑都作为可撤销命令执行，在后台线程渲染

steps.en: Writes SVG, PDF, EPS or PNG

value.en: Illustrator-style editing of the files you receive, with no subscription and the same commands open to scripts
value.zh: 用 Illustrator 的方式编辑收到的文件，不用订阅，同一套命令还能给脚本调用

sources: README.md Downloads: per-OS file names vectorcraft-<ver>-macos-universal.dmg, vectorcraft-<ver>-windows-x64.msi
